_doc: Beta-PERT priors per (role, phase) cell. Edited by hand. See _meta/VAULT_ARCHITECTURE.md sec. 'Bayesian Gantt prediction'.
_calibration_note: Example priors calibrated on real botany/phylogenetics projects: lead.dc ML=270d (~field+lab+bioinformatics for a single-author project). not_lead.dc ML=300d (coauthor projects tend longer). Drafting ML=150/180d. IR symmetric across roles (journal-determined). PERT mean: lead dc≈312d, dr≈174d, ir≈146d; not_lead dc≈365d, dr≈220d, ir≈146d. Recalibrate on your own project history — see ml/README.md.

_nig_strength._note: kappa_0 = pseudo-observations carrying prior weight; a_0 sets IG shape. b_0 derived from elicited variance. kappa_0=0.5 chosen deliberately low: simulation (Bayesian_gantt_system_simulation.R) showed that kappa_0>=2 causes the model to get stuck on a wrong ML for many projects; with kappa_0=0.5 the prior weight is <5% after 10 real observations and the data self-corrects quickly even if PERT estimates are off by 10x.
